description: Encode the CSV parser's state machine transitions as arithmetic/bitwise operations instead of conditional branches, ensuring the CPU pipeline never stalls on mispredictions. CSV has only ~4 states, and transitions can be computed as lookup-table indexed operations.
mathematical_formalization: State encoding: NORMAL=0, IN_QUOTE=1, ESCAPE=2. Transition: next_state = T[current_state][char_class]. Branchless: next_state = (state & quote_mask) ^ (char_class & transition_bits). All computed with AND/OR/XOR, zero branches.
analogical_connections: Constant-time cryptography: CMOV and bitwise select to prevent timing leaks
GPU predicated execution: both branches evaluated, result selected by predicate
Digital circuit combinational logic: state machines without conditional branching
implementation_hypothesis: Encode state as integer 0-2, char class as 0-4. Compute next_state = LOOKUP[state * 5 + char_class] via 15-entry u8 array. Use CMOV for field/row emit signals.
experiment_seed: Measure branch misprediction rates on CSV with varying quote patterns. Compare branchy vs. branchless. Expect <0.1% misprediction for branchless.
